class.name: JarTerrainDetail
class.brief_description: Small, dense objects (grass, pebbles) scattered over the full-detail chunks of a [JarVoxelVolume].
class.description: Details are generated on the mesh threads from the triangles of full-detail (LOD 0) chunks and drawn with one [MultiMesh] per chunk, so they cost little and follow edits automatically. They are not persistent: when a chunk is remeshed they are scattered again (deterministically, per triangle position). Details are not placed on painted ground (see [method JarVoxelVolume.paint]). Add them to [member JarVoxelVolume.population_terrain_details]. For large objects that must be visible from afar and stay in place, use [JarTerrainFeature].

members.member: Instances per square meter of surface (before the rules and the mask remove some).
Distance in meters beyond which a chunk's details are hidden ([member GeometryInstance3D.visibility_range_end]). [code]0[/code] shows them on every full-detail chunk.
Distance in meters beyond which [member far_mesh] replaces [member mesh]. [code]0[/code] disables the far mesh.

A cheaper mesh shown from [member far_distance] to [member draw_distance]. With a material that includes [code]res://addons/jar_voxel_terrain/shaders/jar_population.gdshaderinc[/code] the switch happens per instance, otherwise per chunk.
If [code]true[/code], details cast shadows. Usually not worth the cost for grass.
